title: When Should an Agent Refresh? Adaptive Index Reuse for Efficient Long-Horizon Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.01429v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language agents read code, tool output, and dialogue in contexts that grow at every step. Dynamic sparse attention lets a small indexer choose the earlier tokens each query attends to, but the indexer still scores the whole prefix at every layer. Cross-layer reuse methods such as IndexCache rerun the indexer at only some layers, with one fixed pattern for every input. In an agent, the relevant evidence can change abruptly when a traceback or test result arrives, so fresh selections matter more at some steps than at others. We propose Adaptive Index Reuse (AIR), which keeps IndexCache's execution and learns, for each segment of an agent episode, how many layers refresh their selection. A small controller reads signals from completed computation and the latest tool event, chooses a pattern from a nested library, and learns from terminal task reward under an expected compute budget. translated_title: 智能体何时应刷新？面向高效长程推理的自适应索引复用
translated_abstract: 语言智能体在每一步都会增长的上下文中阅读代码、工具输出和对话。动态稀疏注意力机制允许一个小型索引器为每个查询选择其应关注的早期token，但索引器仍需在每一层对整个前缀进行评分。诸如IndexCache等跨层复用方法只在部分层重新运行索引器，且对所有输入采用同一个固定模式。而在智能体场景中，当错误回溯（traceback）或测试结果出现时，相关证据可能突然改变，因此在某些步骤中刷新选择比其他步骤更为重要。我们提出了自适应索引复用，它保留了IndexCache的执行方式，并为智能体回合的每个片段学习需要刷新选择的层数。一个小型控制器读取来自已完成计算的信号和最新的工具事件，从嵌套模式库中选择一种模式，并在预期计算预算下通过最终任务奖励进行学习。在使用128K上下文的Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507模型上，AIR提升了……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出自适应索引复用（AIR），通过一个轻量控制器根据智能体回合的各阶段片段和最新工具事件，动态决定稀疏注意力索引器需要刷新的层数，并在预期计算预算下利用最终任务奖励进行学习，从而在长程推理中更高效地平衡计算开销与注意力选择的准确性。
en_tdlr: AIR (Adaptive Index Reuse) employs a small controller that dynamically decides how many layers refresh their sparse-attention index selections for each segment of an agent episode, guided by tool events and trained via terminal task reward under an expected compute budget, enabling more efficient long-horizon reasoning.
